the 备注 segments (split on newlines and
) that say 持有 / 常态持有 {{异常效果|…}}, with HTML comments stripped — 龙腾.F's 缴械 is commented out on PRTS
how.names: {{异常效果|X}} → X, {{异常效果|X|免疫}} → X·免疫, {{异常效果|X|反制}} → X·反制
how.applied: only the effects in `effects` become tokens.json `abnormal` flags; every other PRTS effect is listed per token in `unexpressed` (form not modelled / no channel) or `mentions` (named but not held), each with a reason in `unexpressible`
how.re_verify: node tools/build-data.mjs re-checks the whole table (unknown effect, unknown id, fallback drift → build error)

unexpressible.无敌: no channel: the engine HAS an `invulnerable` buff flag (buffs.js flags, e.g. 泥岩 S3 / 敌人 kits use it), but `abnormal` has no mapping for it and Battle._setupUnit reads only healFree / isolated — wiring it is an engine change, not a data one. For several tokens it is also conditional on a form the sim does not model.
unexpressible.不可阻挡: no channel: the engine HAS an `unblockable` flag (buffs.js) but Battle._setupUnit does not read it from `abnormal` (an ENEMY-side concept: an ally unit is blocked by nothing — its blocker releases it through `noBlock`).
unexpressible.阻回: conditional everywhere on PRTS (满血 / 持有者技能开启期间 / 战术点形态); the engine HAS 阻回 as the `noSp` flag (skills.js gainSp), but a from-the-start data flag would be wrong for all of them.
unexpressible.静默: conditional on PRTS (same clause as 阻回, and the 应急承重小组 / 监工专员 常态持有); the engine has a `silence` flag but no from-the-start `abnormal` mapping for it.
unexpressible.沉默: conditional on PRTS (悲叹的仆役: 自身不是特殊形态召唤物时); 沉默 is the engine `silence` status (buffs.js STATUS), reachable only through a status application — `abnormal` has no mapping for it.
unexpressible.强制缴械: 战术点形态 only; the engine has a `disarm` flag but no `abnormal` mapping.
unexpressible.不死: no engine concept (a unit at 0 HP that stays alive); only appears in the 战术点形态 of 磐蟹护卫队 / 眠兽 / 狼群 / 樱桃三号 / 指挥中心, which the sim does not model.
unexpressible.晕眩·反制: 战术点形态 only; 反制 is not a status the engine models.
unexpressible.沉默·反制: 战术点形态 only; 反制 is not a status the engine models.
unexpressible.冻结·反制: 战术点形态 only; 反制 is not a status the engine models.
unexpressible.失衡免疫: no channel: `variants[].immunities` (simdata.js → def.immune → Battle.applyStatus) carries only stun/silence/sleep/frozen/levitate, and the client data reports every one of them `false` for this token.
unexpressible.元素免疫: no channel: 元素损伤 has its own gauge in the engine (elem.*), and neither `abnormal` nor `immunities` maps to it.
unexpressible.无法撤退: no channel: retreat is a player/match action (PlayerState), not a per-unit battle flag.
unexpressible.晕眩·免疫: immunity channel: `variants[].immunities.stun` exists (simdata.js:306 → def.immune → Battle.applyStatus) but the client tables report `stunImmune: false` for these tokens, so PRTS is the only source; populating it is a separate data change.
unexpressible.冻结·免疫: immunity channel: `variants[].immunities.frozen`, same as 晕眩·免疫 (client `frozenImmune: false`).
unexpressible.寒冷·免疫: no channel: 寒冷 has no `immunities` key (only stun/silence/sleep/frozen/levitate) — the engine immunity set has no `cold`.
unexpressible.沉睡·免疫: immunity channel: `variants[].immunities.sleep`, same as 晕眩·免疫 (client `sleepImmune: false`).
unexpressible.沉默·免疫: immunity channel: `variants[].immunities.silence`, same as 晕眩·免疫 (client `silenceImmune: false`); note 沉默·反制 (a different effect) is also unmodelled.
unexpressible.浮空·免疫: immunity channel: `variants[].immunities.levitate`, same as 晕眩·免疫 (client `levitateImmune: false`).
unexpressible.战栗·免疫: no channel: 战栗 (`tremble`) has no `immunities` key.
unexpressible.恐惧·免疫: no channel: 恐惧 has no `immunities` key (`feared` exists internally for enemies but is not part of the token immunity set).
unexpressible.麻痹·免疫: no channel: 麻痹 (`palsy`) has no `immunities` key.
unexpressible.麻痹震颤·免疫: no channel: 麻痹震颤 is not a status the engine models at all.
unexpressible.束缚·免疫: no channel: 束缚 (`bind`) has no `immunities` key.
